newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banorte seeks insurance partner - report.
newsitem.headline: Banorte seeks insurance partner - report.

text.p: Mexican financial group Banorte will shortly reach a decision on settling a strategic alliance in the insurance business, Monterrey daily El Norte said on Tuesday.
"We are listening to proposals and are sure to find what we are looking for in the coming days," El Norte quoted Banorte chairman Roberto Gonzalez Barrera as saying.
Gonzalez said Banorte was also interested in acquiring Banpais, currently being managed by the government, which said on Monday it will invite bids for the bank.

"There has always been interest and we are among those interested. We are also joining forces to see whether we can or cannot, whether we should or should not do it," El Norte quoted Gonzalez as saying.
